title: One successor step of nilpotent reduction lissity
statement: Let a small site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] be given by a precoverage with isomorphisms, composition, base change and pullbacks. Let B be a commutative Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], J an ideal, K a bounded-above derived object of sheaves of modules over the constant coefficient ring [def-weil-pbc-constant-coefficient-scalar-extension], and n at least one. Use finite constant-module local descriptions [def-weil-pbc-locally-constant-finite-type-modules]. If all cohomology sheaves of the derived reductions of K modulo J and modulo J^n have these local descriptions over their respective quotient rings, then all cohomology sheaves of its reduction modulo J^(n+1) have these descriptions over B/J^(n+1). Derived categories and cohomology are [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] and [def-weil-derived-cohomology-sheaves]. This asserts one filtration step, without an induction over all powers or a nilpotent specialization.

proof.text: Choose a bounded-above flat K-flat complex P representing K using good truncation, the functorial bounded-above flat replacement, and the bounded-above flat K-flat criterion. The canonical counit of derivedChangeOfRings identifies the localization of each termwise quotient extension with constantCoefficientScalarExtension applied to K. The ordinary additive extension preserves the termwise bound; its object and map equations give an isomorphism to changeOfRingsComplex.

Put D=B/J^(n+1), A=B/J and E=B/J^n. Construct Q=(J^n)/(J times J^n), a finite A-module, using the Mathlib linear equivalence with the image of J^n in D. This gives the short exact sequence of D-modules Res(Q) to D to Res(E). Constant module presheaves preserve finite limits and colimits (the public constant_preservesFiniteLimits/Colimits helpers in the finite-free truncation module), and Mathlib module sheafification is exact. Tensor their sheafified sequence termwise with the flat complex P_D. Degreewise short exactness gives a short exact sequence of complexes and the Mathlib distinguished triangle of that sequence. Change of rings preserves flat terms and K-flatness.

Compare sheafification with restriction of constant coefficients using restrictSheafificationComparison_isIso. Restriction along a locally surjective ring-sheaf map is fully faithful; the tensor cancellation isomorphisms and the composition comparison for restriction therefore identify the first triangle complex with Res_DA(Q_A tensor P_A), and the last with Res_DE(P_E). The middle is P_D by the constant regular-module/unit isomorphism. All comparisons are chain isomorphisms. Restriction is exact because its underlying abelian-sheaf functor is unchanged, so it commutes with homology.

For the first outer term, resolve the degree-zero constant finite A-module Q by a K-flat complex. Apply the locally constant derived-tensor theorem to this resolution and P_A. Tensoring its quasi-isomorphism with the K-flat P_A is a quasi-isomorphism: its cone is the total tensor of an acyclic cone and P_A. The single-complex total-tensor comparison gives finite locally constant cohomology of Q_A tensor P_A. The hypothesis supplies it for P_E. Since D to A and D to E are surjective, restriction preserves finite constant local models. Both outer terms thus have finite locally constant D-cohomology. D is Noetherian, so distinguished-triangle closure gives the middle term, identified above with the required successor reduction.

theorem locallyConstantFiniteTypeModules_reduction_succ
    {C : Type u} [Category.{u} C] (T : Precoverage C)
    [T.HasIsos] [T.IsStableUnderComposition] [T.IsStableUnderBaseChange] [T.HasPullbacks]
    (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [IsNoetherianRing B] (J : Ideal B)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (constantCoefficientRing T.toGrothendieck B))]
    [∀ I : Ideal B, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (constantCoefficientRing T.toGrothendieck (B ⧸ I)))]
    (K : DerivedCategory
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (constantCoefficientRing T.toGrothendieck B)))
    (hbounded : ∃ b : ℤ, ∀ i : ℤ, b < i →
      IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ i).obj K))
    (hmod : ∀ i : ℤ, IsLocallyConstantFiniteTypeModules T.toGrothendieck (B ⧸ J)
      ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ i).obj
        ((constantCoefficientScalarExtension T.toGrothendieck (Ideal.Quotient.mk J)).obj K)))
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    (hprevious : ∀ i : ℤ, IsLocallyConstantFiniteTypeModules T.toGrothendieck (B ⧸ J ^ n)
      ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ i).obj
        ((constantCoefficientScalarExtension T.toGrothendieck
          (Ideal.Quotient.mk (J ^ n))).obj K))) :
    ∀ i : ℤ, IsLocallyConstantFiniteTypeModules T.toGrothendieck (B ⧸ J ^ (n + 1))
      ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ i).obj
        ((constantCoefficientScalarExtension T.toGrothendieck
          (Ideal.Quotient.mk (J ^ (n + 1)))).obj K))
